route_resolution.adjacent_year_rule: applied to COMMITTEE rows only. The era committees vote in December for the following summer's class, so the two sources stamp different years. The writers vote and announce in the same January, so no year slide is allowed there: it would let a candidate who failed in one year be credited with a neighbouring year's election.
route_resolution.why_not_from_the_note: StatsAPI's notes field is EMPTY on 333 of 354 recipients and several of the 21 that carry one say things like 'No cap logo on plaque'. Defaulting an empty note to the writers' ballot reported 342 BBWAA against 12 committee inductees, which is badly wrong. An unresolved route stays UNKNOWN and is never defaulted.
route_resolution.what_unknown_usually_means: a manager, executive, umpire or Negro Leagues honouree, none of whom appear on a player ballot, or a name the join did not match. Both are visible in the rows themselves.

bref_hof_marker_is_as_of_scrape_not_as_o: every ballot row carries bref_hof_marker_as_of_scrape, which is Baseball-Reference's own enshrinement flag AT THE MOMENT THE PAGE WAS FETCHED and not at the row's election year. Carlos Beltran's 2025 row carries it while his 2025 result was 70.3%, short of the 75% bar. As a model feature it is a perfect leak of the outcome. Use it to cross-check the label and never as an input.
route_matters: the writers elect some Hall of Famers and the era and veterans committees elect the rest, on a different and much longer clock. Owner decision 12 makes any-route induction the primary label, so every row carries its route and the per-route counts are published: a fold whose positives are mostly committee inductions must not be able to pass as model skill.
what_is_not_here: no row is invented. A year that could not be fetched or parsed is in years_failed with its reason, and the covered-year list is published, because a panel silently missing a decade would bias every censoring rule built on it. The StatsAPI side is keyed by MLBAM id and is NOT yet joined to the bbref ids the rest of the module uses; that join is a separate step and until it runs the committee inductees are a list rather than a label.
